training_actions.action: Increase valid web-specific supervision for test-surface versus implementation-surface disambiguation.
training_actions.why: The current packet misses every `test_surface` row while symbol-owner rows are the only stable success case.

training_actions.action: Add more web rows where entrypoint/startup evidence must beat file-level and symbol-level distractors.
training_actions.why: The model misses entrypoint-or-invocation rows and often drifts toward implementation or configuration alternatives with tiny margins.

training_actions.action: Treat the web slice as ambiguity-sensitive rather than shortcut-driven and target sharper label separation, not more generic anti-cheat hardening.
training_actions.why: Wrong predictions are low-margin and near-uniform rather than high-confidence shortcut collapses.
